text: わざマシンを　もって　いって

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus いく says you do it and then go. もって　いく = 'hold it and go', that is 'take it with you'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: Ending a sentence on a て-form is a casual way to ask someone to do something. もって　いって = 'take it with you, please'.
